stages.title: 公开目标与最终声明
stages.premises: 目标是 Mathlib 的 RiemannHypothesis；其余四个公开声明涉及ζ及Dirichlet L函数。
stages.argument: Main.lean 通过 rhOfAll、allChi、claimAll 和 critAll 给出最终声明。先核对 Statements 中的定义，不能只根据定理名称判断证明了什么。

stages.title: 将最终无零点结论接到上游输入
stages.premises: 输入是 Green、VWin 以及统一族的相容性条件。
stages.argument: EveryCharacter.plugWin 调用 shapeWin 和 supplyChi；plugAll 再处理非本原特征。MainConclusion 给出原工程中最终接口的实例。这里保留原代码全部前提。

stages.title: 上同调长度窗口
stages.premises: 输入来自原工程更深的Galois表示、模性与长度估计。
stages.argument: 本阶段输出的是VWin及相关长度窗口，不直接等同于G(x)的上界。其全部上游尚未被本文逐引理转写。

stages.title: 构造宿主与辅助条件
stages.premises: 对一个固定的本原Dirichlet特征ψ，构造满足需求GChi ψ的宿主族。
stages.argument: Supply/HostOfField/SupplyChi 保留长度条件与辅助特征误差条件；模1专门化不会使所有辅助特征消失。

stages.title: 固定常数后选择小参数
stages.premises: eD、eL及正阈值ε1必须在ε之前固定。
stages.argument: FamilyClassConnected 与 DesWin、ShapeWin 的组合产生符合ChainTied的同一数据族。依赖ε或族的辅助常数不可误写成全体统一常数。

stages.title: 在同一个好尺度汇合算术与几何
stages.premises: 数据族必须同时具有EFamC、Win和ChainTied。
stages.argument: WindowInequalityOfArtinInputs/LevelGmLeOnFamilyScales 对每个好尺度选择可用宿主，合并阈值，并调用局部主项与误差界。

stages.title: 主项比较与辅助误差求和
stages.premises: 核心结构提供E=eD+eL≥0及主项比较，辅助误差给出4o的因子。
stages.argument: 模1时o=1，得到G(x)≤x^(1/2+(E+6)ε)+4x^(1/2+ε)。几何比较本身仍引用原工程；后续指数合并已在中文稿完整计算。

stages.title: 合并指数并形成算术窗口
stages.premises: x≥1、ε>0、E≥0，且好窗口可出现在任意远处。
stages.argument: 两项合并≤5x^(1/2+(E+6)ε)；超过x≥5^(1/ε)后，吸收常数5，得到指数1/2+(E+7)ε。再取固定K>|E+7|，得到中文稿的算术窗口定理。

stages.title: 平滑素数函数及变换
stages.argument: 逐项计算Mellin变换，得到Φ=−ζ′/[s(s−1)ζ]−1/(s−1)^2+(1+γ)/(s−1)。中文稿专门化到ζ并检查s=1的可去奇点。

stages.title: 单侧窗口控制高阶导数
stages.argument: 取A_k=(-1)^k Φ^(k)/k!；使用|A_k(σ+it)|+Re A_k(σ)与|g|+g=2 max(g,0)。中文稿取σ=336、k=ceil(420U)，明确估计两侧尾部。

stages.title: 极点迫使导数增长并产生矛盾
stages.premises: ζ的零点对应非零留数的单极点；ζ专门化另证明正实轴无极点。
stages.argument: 分离唯一最近极点，用Cauchy估计得到导数下界。结合窗口上界导出0<b≤(B+U+C)q^U→0，q∈(0,1)。

stages.title: 将排除边界推进到二分之一
stages.premises: 固定K后，可以任取足够小的正ε；好尺度无界。
stages.argument: 若β>1/2，选1/2<θ<min(β,1)，再取1/2+Kε<θ。窗口排除Re s>θ的零点，与β矛盾。

stages.title: 模1专门化及函数方程收尾
stages.premises: 右侧无零点；排除ζ在0处及平凡零点的特殊情况。
stages.argument: EveryCharacter在模1时给出ζ右半平面非消失。函数方程把左侧非平凡零点映到已排除的右侧，因此所有非平凡零点实部为1/2。

def VVle (E : Type) [Field E] [NumberField E] (t : ℕ) (B : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (Ω : Type) [Field Ω] [Algebra E Ω] [IsAlgClosure E Ω] (ld : ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], Formalism.GaloisCohomology.LData E Ω p),
    (∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (e : ℕ), 0 < e → e < t → Formalism.GaloisCohomology.shaLen (ld p) (e : ℤ) ≠ ⊤) ∧
    ∀ S : Finset Nat.Primes,
      ∑ l ∈ S, Real.log (l : ℕ) *
        ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, ((@Formalism.GaloisCohomology.shaLen E Ω _ _ _ _ _ l ⟨l.2⟩ (@ld l ⟨l.2⟩) (e : ℤ)).toNat : ℝ) ≤ B

def IsChiField (ψ : PChar) (e q d : ℕ) (E : Type) [Field E] [NumberField E] : Prop :=
  ∃ (N : ℕ) (_ : NeZero N) (j : E →ₐ[ℚ] CyclotomicField N ℚ) (ζ : CyclotomicField N ℚ),
    2 ^ (e + 2) ∣ N ∧ ψ.N ∣ N ∧ q ∣ N ∧ d ∣ N ∧ IsPrimitiveRoot ζ N ∧
    ∀ (τ : CyclotomicField N ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] CyclotomicField N ℚ) (a : ℕ), τ ζ = ζ ^ a →
      ((∀ x : E, τ (j x) = j x) ↔
        (a ≡ 1 [MOD 2 ^ (e + 2)] ∨ a + 1 ≡ 0 [MOD 2 ^ (e + 2)]) ∧ ψ.val a = 1 ∧
          jacobiSym (a : ℤ) q = 1 ∧ jacobiSym (a : ℤ) d = 1)

structure WinPair (eps Y : ℝ) (q d : ℕ) : Prop where
  q_prime : q.Prime
  q_mod : q % 8 = 3
  q_lo : Y ^ (eps / 5) / 2 < Real.log q
  q_up : Real.log q ≤ Y ^ (eps / 5)
  d_prime : d.Prime
  d_mod : d % 16 = 7
  d_lo : Y ^ (eps / 5) * Real.log Y ^ 2 / 2 < Real.log d
  d_up : Real.log d ≤ Y ^ (eps / 5) * Real.log Y ^ 2
  d_q : q ∣ d + 1
  d_small : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ≠ 2 → (p : ℝ) ≤ Y ^ (eps / 5) → p ∣ d + 1

def PageN (eps x : ℝ) (e : ℕ) : Prop := x ^ (2 + 8 * eps) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ e ∧ (2 : ℝ) ^ e ≤ 2 * x ^ (2 + 8 * eps)

def VAt (ψ : PChar) (eps Ct : ℝ) (q d e : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (E : Type) [Field E] [NumberField E], IsChiField ψ e q d E → VVle E ⌊x ^ Ct⌋₊ (Real.sqrt (Real.exp (x ^ eps)))

def VWinAt (ψ : PChar) (Ct : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ eps : ℝ, 0 < eps → eps < 1 / 52 → ∀ e : ℝ → ℕ, (∀ x ≥ (1 : ℝ), PageN eps x (e x)) →
    ∃ J : ℝ, 1 ≤ J ∧ ∃ X0 : ℝ, ∀ X ≥ X0, ∀ q d : ℕ, WinPair eps (X ^ (1 / J)) q d →
      ∃ Y : ℝ, X ^ (1 / J) ≤ Y ∧ Y ^ (2 : ℝ) ≤ X ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, Y ≤ x → x ≤ Y ^ (2 : ℝ) → VAt ψ eps Ct q d (e x) x

def VWin : Prop := ∀ ψ : PChar, VWinAt ψ 401

theorem VVle.mono {E : Type} [Field E] [NumberField E] {t t' : ℕ} {B B' : ℝ} (h : VVle E t B) (ht : t' ≤ t) (hB : B ≤ B') :
    VVle E t' B' := by
  intro Ω _ _ _ ld
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h Ω ld
  refine ⟨fun p _ e he1 he2 => h1 p e he1 (lt_of_lt_of_le he2 ht), fun S => ?_⟩
  refine le_trans ?_ (le_trans (h2 S) hB)
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro l _
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.log_natCast_nonneg _)
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
  · intro e he
    simp only [Finset.mem_Ico] at he ⊢
    omega
  · intro e _ _
    positivity

theorem exists_pageN (eps : ℝ) (he : 0 < eps) : ∃ e : ℝ → ℕ, ∀ x ≥ (1 : ℝ), PageN eps x (e x) := by
  have : ∀ x : ℝ, ∃ e : ℕ, x ≥ 1 → PageN eps x e := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ≥ 1
    · have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ x ^ (2 + 8 * eps) := Real.one_le_rpow hx (by linarith)
      obtain ⟨n, a, b⟩ := exists_nat_pow_near h1 (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
      refine ⟨n + 1, fun _ => ⟨b.le, ?_⟩⟩
      rw [pow_succ]; linarith
    · exact ⟨0, fun h => absurd h hx⟩
  choose e he using this
  exact ⟨e, he⟩

theorem vvRecord (D : D7) (B : ℝ) (h : VVle D.host.E D.R.t B) :
    ShaFinOdd D ∧ Summable (vvTerm D) ∧ ∑' l, vvTerm D l ≤ B := by

  letI := D.nd.algOm
  haveI := D.nd.acOm
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h D.nd.Om D.nd.ldat
  have key : ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], ((∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 D.R.t, D.what₂.shaLen p e : ℚ) : ℝ) =
      ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 D.R.t, ((Formalism.GaloisCohomology.shaLen (D.nd.ldat p) (e : ℤ)).toNat : ℝ) := by
    intro p _
    push_cast
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e he => ?_
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := Finset.mem_Ico.1 he
    rw [D.nd.sha_eq p e a b _ (ENat.coe_toNat (h1 p e a b)).symm]
    norm_cast
  have bd : ∀ l : ℕ, 0 ≤ vvTerm D l ∧ ∀ hl : l.Prime, vvTerm D l ≤ Real.log l *
      ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 D.R.t, ((@Formalism.GaloisCohomology.shaLen _ D.nd.Om _ _ _ _ _ l ⟨hl⟩ (@Formalism.BasicNotions.NData.ldat _ _ _ D.nd l ⟨hl⟩) (e : ℤ)).toNat : ℝ) := by
    intro l
    by_cases hl : l.Prime
    · haveI : Fact l.Prime := ⟨hl⟩
      have hk := key l
      have hn : 0 ≤ Real.log l * ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 D.R.t, ((Formalism.GaloisCohomology.shaLen (D.nd.ldat l) (e : ℤ)).toNat : ℝ) :=
        mul_nonneg (Real.log_natCast_nonneg _) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      unfold vvTerm
      split_ifs
      all_goals first
        | exact ⟨le_rfl, fun _ => hn⟩
        | (rw [hk, mul_comm]; exact ⟨hn, fun _ => le_rfl⟩)
    · have : vvTerm D l = 0 := by unfold vvTerm; simp [hl]
      exact ⟨this.ge, fun h => absurd h hl⟩
  have part : ∀ s : Finset ℕ, ∑ l ∈ s, vvTerm D l ≤ B := by
    intro s

    refine le_trans ?_ (h2 (s.subtype Nat.Prime))
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter_of_ne (p := Nat.Prime) (fun l _ hne => by
      by_contra hl
      exact hne (by unfold vvTerm; simp [hl])), ← Finset.sum_subtype_eq_sum_filter]

  refine ⟨?_, summable_of_sum_le (fun l => (bd l).1) part, Real.tsum_le_of_sum_le (fun l => (bd l).1) part⟩

theorem log_sq_le_rpow {eps : ℝ} (h : 0 < eps) :
    ∃ x0 : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x0, Real.log x ^ 2 ≤ x ^ eps := by
  have h1 := (isLittleO_log_rpow_atTop (half_pos h)).bound one_pos
  obtain ⟨x0, hx0⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 h1
  refine ⟨max x0 1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have hx1 : 1 ≤ x := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hx
  have h2 := hx0 x (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hx)
  have hp : 0 ≤ x ^ (eps / 2) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg hx1), abs_of_nonneg hp,
    one_mul] at h2
  have h3 : x ^ eps = (x ^ (eps / 2)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [sq, ← Real.rpow_add (by linarith)]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [h3]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.log_nonneg hx1) h2 2

theorem divinN_at {D : D7} (L : SizeData₂ D) (j : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (hj : j ∈ SizeData₂.lifts D)
    (hN : LinkN_at L j C) (hs : Summable (vvTerm D)) (hb : ∑' l, vvTerm D l ≤ L.sc.b)
    (hd : L.dZ0 j = D.what₂.D0) (hlog : Real.log L.sc.x ^ 2 ≤ L.sc.x ^ L.sc.eps) :
    DIVinN_at L j (|C| + 1) := by
  have hx : 0 < L.sc.x := lt_trans one_pos L.sc.one_lt_alt
  have hy : 1 ≤ L.sc.x ^ L.sc.eps := Real.one_le_rpow L.sc.one_lt_alt.le L.sc.eps_pos.le
  have hf : (1 : ℝ) ≤ D.R.f := by
    have : 0 < D.R.f := by unfold Ranks.f Ranks.n; positivity
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hm : (1 : ℝ) ≤ D.R.m := by
    have h := Finset.mem_Icc.1 hj
    exact_mod_cast le_trans h.1 h.2
  have hbpos : 0 < L.sc.b := Real.exp_pos _
  have hNc : 0 ≤ L.Nc := by
    simp only [SizeData₂.Nc, budgetNc, rankBudget, bSize]
    positivity
  have hB : L.B0 = (D.R.f : ℝ) * D.R.m * L.sc.b * L.sc.x ^ L.sc.eps := rfl
  have hL : L.sc.L = L.sc.x ^ L.sc.eps := rfl
  have hE := hN hs
  rw [hd, hL] at hE
  unfold DIVinN_at
  refine le_trans hE (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  set y := L.sc.x ^ L.sc.eps with hydef
  have hfm : 1 ≤ (D.R.f : ℝ) * D.R.m := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hf hm
  have hbB : L.sc.b ≤ L.B0 := by
    rw [hB]
    have h1 : 1 ≤ (D.R.f : ℝ) * D.R.m * y := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hfm hy
    nlinarith
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ L.B0 := le_trans hbpos.le hbB
  have hP1 : (D.R.f : ℝ) * D.R.m * L.sc.b * y ^ 2 = y * L.B0 := by rw [hB]; ring
  have hP2 : Real.log L.sc.x ^ 2 * L.Nc ≤ y * L.Nc := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlog hNc
  have hP0 : 0 ≤ y * L.B0 + Real.log L.sc.x ^ 2 * L.Nc := by positivity
  rw [hP1]
  have h1 : C * (y * L.B0 + Real.log L.sc.x ^ 2 * L.Nc) ≤ |C| * (y * (L.B0 + L.Nc)) :=
    le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) hP0)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (abs_nonneg C))
  have h2 : L.B0 ≤ y * (L.B0 + L.Nc) := by nlinarith
  have h3 : (|C| + 1) * y * (L.B0 + L.Nc) = |C| * (y * (L.B0 + L.Nc)) + y * (L.B0 + L.Nc) := by ring
  rw [h3]
  linarith

lemma mem_psi (A0 : AddSubgroup H) (ψ : AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ) : ψ ∈ PsiA A0 ↔ ∀ s ∈ A0, ψ (0, s) = 1 := by
  classical
  unfold PsiA

lemma sum_A (A0 : AddSubgroup H) [Fintype A0] (ψ : AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ) (s t : H) (hs : s ∈ A0) :
    ∑ u : A0, ψ (-(e1 (s + (u : H) - t))) = if ψ ∈ PsiA A0 then (Fintype.card A0 : ℂ) * ψ (e1 t) else 0 := by
  have hg : ∀ u : A0, (-(e1 (s + (u : H) - t)) : E0 × H) = e1 t + (0, -s) + (0, -(u : H)) := by
    intro u
    ext
    · simp [e1]
    · simp [e1]
    · simp [e1]; abel
  simp_rw [hg, AddChar.map_add_eq_mul]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  split_ifs with h
  · have h' := (mem_psi A0 ψ).1 h
    rw [h' _ (A0.neg_mem hs), Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun (u : A0) _ => h' _ (A0.neg_mem u.2))]
    simp [mul_comm]
  · let φ : AddChar A0 ℂ := ψ.compAddMonoidHom ((AddMonoidHom.inr E0 H).comp A0.subtype)
    have hφ : ∀ u : A0, φ u = ψ (0, (u : H)) := fun u => rfl
    have hne : φ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply h
      rw [mem_psi]
      intro v hv
      rw [← hφ ⟨v, hv⟩, h0, AddChar.zero_apply]
    have h1 := AddChar.sum_eq_zero_iff_ne_zero.2 hne
    have h2 : ∑ u : A0, ψ (0, -(u : H)) = ∑ u : A0, φ u := by
      rw [← Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.neg A0) φ]
      rfl
    rw [h2, h1, mul_zero]

lemma sum_Th (A0 : AddSubgroup H) [Fintype A0] (D : ArithData H) (ell : AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ → ℂ) (T2 : Finset H)

    intro s hs
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul, sum_A A0 _ s t (hT2 s hs), ite_mul, zero_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter, Finset.mul_sum]

  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hin, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, phiSet_card]
  have hH : (Fintype.card H : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  unfold delta2
  push_cast
  field_simp

lemma th_le (D : ArithData H) (ell : AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ → ℂ) (T2 : Finset H) (x b b' η X' θ A : ℝ) (u0 t : H) (w : E0 × H → ℝ)
    (hx : 3 ≤ x) (hb : 0 < b) (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hX' : 0 < X') (_hb' : 0 < b') (hbX : b' * X' ≤ x * b) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hA : |A / b - x| ≤ 1) (hwpos : ∀ ρ, InPhi ρ → 0 < w ρ)
    (hwthick : ∀ ρ, IsThickAt T2 u0 ρ → b ≤ w ρ ∧ w ρ ≤ b + η + 1)
    (hwthin : ∀ ρ, InPhi ρ → ¬ IsThickAt T2 u0 ρ → w ρ ≤ 2 * b')
    (hThin : ThinScales D ell X' θ) (hLip : LipW D ell) :
    (Th D ell T2 b (A / b) u0 t).re ≤ (De D ell A t w).re + 2 * fPl H * (3 * (x + 1) * (η + 1) + (x + 1) * b * θ) := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_le.1 hA
  have hA1 : (x - 1) * b ≤ A := by
    have : x - 1 ≤ A / b := by linarith
    rwa [le_div_iff₀ hb] at this
  have hA2 : A ≤ (x + 1) * b := by
    have : A / b ≤ x + 1 := by linarith
    rwa [div_le_iff₀ hb] at this
  have hA0 : 0 < A := lt_of_lt_of_le (by nlinarith) hA1
  have hTh : Th D ell T2 b (A / b) u0 t = (1 / ((PhiSet (H := H)).card : ℂ)) *
      ∑ g ∈ univ.filter (fun g : E0 × H => ¬ InPhi (g + topPl t)), ∑ ψ : AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ,
        ψ (-g) * (if IsThickAt T2 u0 (cconj + g + topPl t) then (b : ℂ) * GPsi D ell ψ (A / b) else 0) := by
    unfold Th
    congr 1
    have : ∀ g : E0 × H, ∑ ψ : AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ,
        ψ (-g) * (if IsThickAt T2 u0 (cconj + g + topPl t) then (b : ℂ) * GPsi D ell ψ (A / b) else 0)
        = if IsThickAt T2 u0 (cconj + g + topPl t) then
          ∑ ψ : AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ, ψ (-g) * ((b : ℂ) * GPsi D ell ψ (A / b)) else 0 := by
      intro g
      split_ifs <;> simp
    simp_rw [this]
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.filter_filter, thick_filter,
      Finset.sum_image (fun s _ s' _ h => thick_inj u0 t (Set.mem_univ s) (Set.mem_univ s') h)]
    rfl
  have hn := CR.norm_avg_le (univ.filter (fun g : E0 × H => ¬ InPhi (g + topPl t))) (CR.card_S_le t _ (Finset.Subset.refl _))
    (fun g ψ => ((w (cconj + g + topPl t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * GPsi D ell ψ (A / w (cconj + g + topPl t))
      - (if IsThickAt T2 u0 (cconj + g + topPl t) then (b : ℂ) * GPsi D ell ψ (A / b) else 0))
    (3 * (x + 1) * (η + 1) + (x + 1) * b * θ) (by positivity) (by
      intro g hg ψ
      have hρ := CR.partner_inPhi t (Finset.mem_filter.1 hg).2
      have hw0 := hwpos _ hρ
      have p1 : 0 ≤ 3 * (x + 1) * (η + 1) := by positivity
      have p2 : 0 ≤ (x + 1) * b * θ := by positivity
      by_cases hth : IsThickAt T2 u0 (cconj + g + topPl t)
      · simp only [if_pos hth]
        obtain ⟨k1, k2⟩ := hwthick _ hth
        have hl := hLip ψ A (w (cconj + g + topPl t)) b hA0 hw0 hb
        rw [min_eq_right k1, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)] at hl
        have e1 : 3 * A / b ≤ 3 * (x + 1) := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ hb]; nlinarith
        have e2 : 3 * A / b * (w (cconj + g + topPl t) - b) ≤ 3 * (x + 1) * (η + 1) :=
          mul_le_mul e1 (by linarith) (by linarith) (by positivity)
        linarith
      · simp only [if_neg hth, sub_zero]
        have hw2 := hwthin _ hρ hth
        have hy : X' / 3 ≤ A / w (cconj + g + topPl t) := by
          rw [le_div_iff₀ hw0]
          have k1 : X' / 3 * w (cconj + g + topPl t) ≤ X' / 3 * (2 * b') :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw2 (by positivity)
          nlinarith
        have ht' := hThin ψ _ hy
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hw0]
        have : w (cconj + g + topPl t) * ‖GPsi D ell ψ (A / w (cconj + g + topPl t))‖ ≤ (x + 1) * b * θ :=
          calc w (cconj + g + topPl t) * ‖GPsi D ell ψ (A / w (cconj + g + topPl t))‖
            ≤ w (cconj + g + topPl t) * (A / w (cconj + g + topPl t) * θ) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht' hw0.le
          _ = A * θ := by field_simp
          _ ≤ (x + 1) * b * θ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hA2 hθ
        linarith)
  have hre := (abs_le.1 (le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _) hn)).1
  have e : (De D ell A t w).re - (Th D ell T2 b (A / b) u0 t).re = ((1 / ((PhiSet (H := H)).card : ℂ)) *
      ∑ g ∈ univ.filter (fun g : E0 × H => ¬ InPhi (g + topPl t)), ∑ ψ : AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ,
        ψ (-g) * (((w (cconj + g + topPl t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * GPsi D ell ψ (A / w (cconj + g + topPl t))
      - (if IsThickAt T2 u0 (cconj + g + topPl t) then (b : ℂ) * GPsi D ell ψ (A / b) else 0))).re := by
    rw [CR.De_re, hTh]
    unfold balTop
    rw [← Complex.sub_re, ← mul_sub, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine congrArg Complex.re (congrArg _ (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun g _ => ?_))
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ψ _ => by rw [CR.GC_host]; ring
  rw [← e] at hre
  linarith

lemma move (D : ArithData H) (ell : AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ → ℂ) {x Cd y : ℝ} (hx : 3 ≤ x) (hCd : 0 ≤ Cd)
    (hy : |y - x| ≤ 1) (hDer : DerivInt D ell Cd) (ψ : AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ) (hψ0 : ψ ≠ 0) :
    ‖GPsi D ell ψ y - GPsi D ell ψ x‖ ≤ Real.log (x + 1) + Cd + ‖ell ψ‖ := by
  obtain ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ := abs_le.1 hy
  have hd := hDer.1 ψ hψ0 y x (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hmax : max y x ≤ x + 1 := max_le (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hmax1 : 1 ≤ max y x := le_trans (by linarith) (le_max_right y x)
  have hlog : Real.log (max y x) ≤ Real.log (x + 1) := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hmax
  have hlog0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (max y x) := Real.log_nonneg hmax1
  have hs : 0 ≤ Real.log (max y x) + Cd + ‖ell ψ‖ := by positivity
  have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hy hs

lemma triv (D : ArithData H) (ell : AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ → ℂ) {x Cd : ℝ} (hx : 3 ≤ x) (hCd : 0 ≤ Cd)

    unfold GPsi
    rw [if_neg hψ0]
    simp
  rw [h1, max_eq_left (by linarith), abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)] at hd
  have h2 : ‖GPsi D ell ψ x‖ ≤ ‖GPsi D ell ψ x - ell ψ‖ + ‖ell ψ‖ := by
    simpa using norm_add_le (GPsi D ell ψ x - ell ψ) (ell ψ)
  have h3 : 0 ≤ Real.log x := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  nlinarith

  intro s hs

private theorem chr_bounded (Λ : Level) (φ : Frame) (H : HostRaw φ) (ψ : AddChar (E0 × φ.A) ℂ) (h : ψ ∈ PsiA φ.A0)

    have e : φ.iod * φ.iod = 1 := by

  have hv : (chr φ ψ φ.iod : ℂ) * (chr φ ψ φ.iod : ℂ) = 1 := by
    rw [← Units.val_mul, hsq, Units.val_one]
  rcases mul_self_eq_one_iff.mp hv with h1 | h1
  · left
    refine ⟨⟨hT, Units.ext (by simpa using h1)⟩, ?_⟩
    intro hK

  · right

theorem exists_small_eps (C : ℝ) {δ ε₁ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (h1 : 0 < ε₁) : ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < ε₁ ∧ C * ε ≤ δ := by
  have hp : 0 < |C| + 1 := by positivity
  have h0 : 0 < min (ε₁ / 2) (δ / (|C| + 1)) := lt_min (by linarith) (div_pos hδ hp)
  refine ⟨_, h0, lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith), ?_⟩
  have a1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) h0.le
  have a2 : min (ε₁ / 2) (δ / (|C| + 1)) ≤ δ / (|C| + 1) := min_le_right _ _
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hp] at a2
  nlinarith

theorem level_of_tiedWin {Λ : Level} {la : ℝ} (h112 : ChebyshevInequalityOnWindows @core @Tied Λ) (hB : Λ.FormBAt la)

  obtain ⟨eD, eL, ε₁, h1, h⟩ := h
  intro ψ hψ s hs
  have hm1 : min (s.re - 1 / 2) (1 / 2) ≤ s.re - 1 / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hm2 : min (s.re - 1 / 2) (1 / 2) ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_right _ _

  obtain ⟨Fm, hE, hW, hT⟩ := h ε hε0 hεlt
  obtain ⟨x1, hx⟩ := h112 eD eL ε hε0 Fm hE hT
  refine hB (1 / 2 + min (s.re - 1 / 2) (1 / 2) / 2) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    (((windows_iff _ la).1 hW).mono (x0 := max x1 1) fun y hy hw => ?_) ψ hψ s (by linarith)

def ramp (f : ℕ → ℂ) (y : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊y⌋₊ + 1), (Λ n : ℂ) * f n * ((max (y / n - 1) 0 : ℝ) : ℂ)

open Classical in

def Gchi {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (y : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  if χ = 1 then
    ramp (fun n => χ n) y - ((y * Real.log y : ℝ) : ℂ) + (((1 + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) * y : ℝ) : ℂ)
  else
    ramp (fun n => χ n) y + (y : ℂ) * (deriv (DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ) 1 / DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ 1)

def G (y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (ramp (fun _ => 1) y).re - y * Real.log y + (1 + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) * y

structure CharFamily where
  ι : Type
  [fin : Fintype ι]
  N : ι → ℕ
  [nz : ∀ i, NeZero (N i)]
  χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (N i)
  a : ι → ℝ
  a_pos : ∀ i, 0 < a i
  adm : ∀ i, N i = 1 ∨ χ i ≠ 1

attribute [instance] CharFamily.fin CharFamily.nz

def Gm (F : CharFamily) (y : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ i, F.a i * (Gchi (F.χ i) y).re

def ZeroFree (F : CharFamily) (θ : ℝ) : Prop :=

def WindowHyp (F : CharFamily) (θ δ : ℝ) : Prop :=

    ∫ y in Set.Icc Y (Y ^ (1 + δ)), R y * y ^ (-θ - 1) ≤ Y ^ η

    ∫ a, (E a + ∑' n, T n a) ∂μ = ∫ a, E a ∂μ + ∑' n, ∫ a, T n a ∂μ := by
  let F : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ := fun n => Nat.casesOn n E T
  have hF : ∀ n, Integrable (F n) μ := fun n => by
    cases n with
    | zero => exact hE
    | succ n => exact hT n
  have hFs : Summable fun n => ∫ a, ‖F n a‖ ∂μ := (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp hs
  have h := hasSum_integral_of_summable_integral_norm hF hFs
  have h2 : ∀ a, ∑' n, F n a = E a + ∑' n, T n a := fun a =>
    ((summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun n => F n a) 1).mp (hp a)).tsum_eq_zero_add
  simp_rw [h2] at h
  rw [← h.tsum_eq, h.summable.tsum_eq_zero_add]
  rfl

theorem mellin_Gchi_modOne_int (n : ℕ) (s : ℂ) (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => ((max (y / n - 1) 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (y : ℂ) ^ (-s - 1)) (Ioi 1) := by
  have ha : (-s).re < -1 := by simp; linarith
  have hb : (-s - 1).re < -1 := by simp; linarith
  refine Integrable.mono' (integrableOn_Ioi_norm_cpow_of_lt ha zero_lt_one) ?_ ?_
  · refine AEStronglyMeasurable.mul ?_ (integrableOn_Ioi_cpow_of_lt hb zero_lt_one).1
    exact Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable (by fun_prop)
  · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi fun y hy => ?_
    have hy1 : (1 : ℝ) < y := hy
    have hy0 : (0 : ℝ) < y := by linarith
    have hyC : (y : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hy0.ne'

      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
      · simpa using hy0.le
      · exact div_le_self hy0.le (by exact_mod_cast hn)
    have h2 : max (y / n - 1) 0 ≤ y := max_le (by linarith) hy0.le
    rw [norm_mul, cpow_sub _ _ hyC, cpow_one, norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_max_right _ _), Real.norm_of_nonneg hy0.le]
    calc _ ≤ y * (‖(y : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖ / y) := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by field_simp

theorem mellin_Gchi_modOne_term (n : ℕ) (s : ℂ) (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    ∫ y in Ioi (1 : ℝ), ((ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℝ) : ℂ) *

theorem mellin_Gchi_modOne_log_int (s : ℂ) (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => ((Real.log y : ℝ) : ℂ) * (y : ℂ) ^ (-s)) (Ioi 1) ∧
    Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => ((Real.log y : ℝ) : ℂ) * (y : ℂ) ^ (-s + 1)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have ha : (-s).re < -1 := by simp; linarith
  set e : ℝ := (s.re - 1) / 2 with he
  have he0 : 0 < e := by linarith
  have key : ∀ (c : ℂ) (y : ℝ), 1 < y →
      ‖((Real.log y : ℝ) : ℂ) * (y : ℂ) ^ c‖ ≤ y ^ (e + c.re) / e := by
    intro c y hy

      Complex.norm_cpow_eq_rpow_re_of_pos hy0, Real.rpow_add hy0]
    calc _ ≤ y ^ e / e * y ^ c.re := by
          gcongr
          exact Real.log_le_rpow_div hy0.le he0

  constructor
  · have hc : e + (-s).re < -1 := by simp; linarith
    refine Integrable.mono' ((integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt hc zero_lt_one).div_const e) ?_ ?_
    · refine AEStronglyMeasurable.mul ?_ (integrableOn_Ioi_cpow_of_lt ha zero_lt_one).1
      exact (Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp Real.measurable_log).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi fun y hy => key _ y hy
  · have hc : 0 < -(e + (-s + 1).re) := by simp; linarith
    have h := (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop hc).div_const e
    rw [neg_neg, zero_div] at h
    refine squeeze_zero_norm' ?_ h
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 1] with y hy using key _ y hy

  simp only [ofReal_one, one_cpow, Real.log_one, ofReal_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero] at h

theorem mellin_Gchi_modOne (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) (s : ℂ) (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    ∫ y in Ioi (1 : ℝ), Gchi χ y * (y : ℂ) ^ (-s - 1) =
      -(deriv riemannZeta s / riemannZeta s + 1 / (s - 1) + 1 - (1 + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) * s) /
        (s * (s - 1)) := by
  have h1 : χ = 1 := DirichletCharacter.level_one χ
  have h2 : ∀ n : ℕ, χ n = 1 := fun n => by
    rw [h1]; exact MulChar.one_apply (isUnit_of_subsingleton _)
  have ha : (-s).re < -1 := by simp; linarith
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hs
    linarith
  have hs1 : s - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Complex.re h
    simp at this
    linarith
  let T : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ := fun n y => ((ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (((max (y / n - 1) 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (y : ℂ) ^ (-s - 1))
  let E : ℝ → ℂ := fun y => (1 + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) * (y : ℂ) ^ (-s) -
    ((Real.log y : ℝ) : ℂ) * (y : ℂ) ^ (-s)
  have hz : ∀ y : ℝ, ∀ n ∉ Finset.range (⌊y⌋₊ + 1), T n y = 0 := by
    intro y n hn
    have hn' : ⌊y⌋₊ + 1 ≤ n := by simpa using hn
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < n := by
      have : 0 < n := by omega
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hlt : y < n := by
      have h1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one y
      have h2 : ((⌊y⌋₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn'
      push_cast at h2
      linarith
    have : max (y / n - 1) 0 = 0 := by
      apply max_eq_right
      have := (div_lt_one hpos).mpr hlt
      linarith
    simp [T, this]
  have hc : EqOn (fun y : ℝ => Gchi χ y * (y : ℂ) ^ (-s - 1))
      (fun y => E y + ∑' n, T n y) (Ioi 1) := by
    intro y hy
    have hy1 : (1 : ℝ) < y := hy
    have hyC : (y : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (zero_lt_one.trans hy1).ne'
    have h3 : (y : ℂ) ^ (-s) = y * (y : ℂ) ^ (-s - 1) := by
      rw [cpow_sub _ _ hyC, cpow_one]
      field_simp
    beta_reduce
    rw [tsum_eq_sum (hz y)]
    simp only [Gchi, if_pos h1, h2, ramp, T, E, h3, mul_one, ← mul_assoc,
      ← Finset.sum_mul]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hi := (mellin_Gchi_modOne_log_int s hs).1
  have hi2 := integrableOn_Ioi_cpow_of_lt ha zero_lt_one
  have hsum : Summable fun n => ∫ y in Ioi (1 : ℝ), ‖T n y‖ := by
    have hσ : 1 < ((s.re : ℝ) : ℂ).re := by simpa using hs
    rw [← Complex.summable_ofReal]
    refine ((ArithmeticFunction.LSeriesSummable_vonMangoldt hσ).div_const
      ((s.re : ℂ) * (s.re - 1))).congr fun n => ?_
    rw [← mellin_Gchi_modOne_term n _ hσ, ← integral_complex_ofReal]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun y hy => ?_
    have hy0 : (0 : ℝ) < y := zero_lt_one.trans hy
    simp only [T]
    rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_max_right _ _), Complex.norm_cpow_eq_rpow_re_of_pos hy0]
    have : (y : ℂ) ^ (-(s.re : ℂ) - 1) = ((y ^ (-s - 1).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [ofReal_cpow hy0.le]
      simp
    rw [this]
    simp
  rw [setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi hc,
    mellin_Gchi_modOne_sum T E (fun n => (mellin_Gchi_modOne_int n s hs).const_mul _)
      ((hi2.const_mul _).sub hi) hsum (fun y => summable_of_ne_finset_zero (hz y))]
  simp only [T, E, mellin_Gchi_modOne_term _ s hs]
  rw [tsum_div_const, integral_sub (hi2.const_mul _) hi, integral_const_mul,
    integral_Ioi_cpow_of_lt ha zero_lt_one, mellin_Gchi_modOne_log s hs]
  have h4 := ArithmeticFunction.LSeries_vonMangoldt_eq_deriv_riemannZeta_div hs
  rw [LSeries] at h4
  rw [h4, neg_div (riemannZeta s)]
  have e2 : -s + 1 = -(s - 1) := by ring
  rw [e2]
  generalize deriv riemannZeta s / riemannZeta s = D
  simp only [ofReal_one, one_cpow]
  field_simp
  ring

theorem poleData_abstract (g : ℂ → ℂ) (hg : Differentiable ℂ g) (h1 : g 1 ≠ 0) (k : ℂ) :
    ∃ Φ : ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ s, s ≠ 1 → Φ s =
        -(deriv g s / g s - s * (deriv g 1 / g 1) + k * (1 - s)) / (s * (s - 1))) ∧
      (∀ ρ, ρ ≠ 0 → g ρ ≠ 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ Φ ρ) ∧
      (∀ ρ, ρ ≠ 0 → ∃ m : ℕ, (m = 0 ↔ g ρ ≠ 0) ∧ ∃ h : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ h ρ ∧
        ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[≠] ρ, Φ s = (m : ℂ) * (-1 / (ρ * (ρ - 1))) / (s - ρ) + h s) ∧
      (∀ z, ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝[≠] z, g w ≠ 0) := by
  have hA : ∀ z, AnalyticAt ℂ g z := fun z => hg.analyticAt z
  have hnz : ∀ z, ¬ ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 z, g w = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    have hon : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g Set.univ := fun w _ => hA w
    have hzero := hon.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero isPreconnected_univ
      (Set.mem_univ z) hz
    exact h1 (hzero (Set.mem_univ 1))
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℂ, c = deriv g 1 / g 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : ℂ → ℂ, N = fun s => deriv g s / g s - s * c + k * (1 - s) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hNs : ∀ s, N s = deriv g s / g s - s * c + k * (1 - s) := fun s => by rw [hN]
  have hN1 : N 1 = 0 := by rw [hNs, hc]; ring
  have hUo : IsOpen {s | g s ≠ 0} := isOpen_ne_fun hg.continuous continuous_const
  have hNd : DifferentiableOn ℂ N {s | g s ≠ 0} := by
    intro s hs
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℂ (deriv g) s := (hA s).deriv.differentiableAt
    have hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun s => deriv g s / g s - s * c + k * (1 - s)) s :=
      ((hd.div (hA s).differentiableAt hs).sub (differentiableAt_id.mul (differentiableAt_const c))).add
        ((differentiableAt_const k).mul ((differentiableAt_const 1).sub differentiableAt_id))
    rw [hN]
    exact hd2.differentiableWithinAt
  have hDd : DifferentiableOn ℂ (dslope N 1) {s | g s ≠ 0} :=
    (differentiableOn_dslope (hUo.mem_nhds h1)).mpr hNd
  have hPhi : ∀ s, s ≠ 1 → -(dslope N 1 s) / s =
      -(deriv g s / g s - s * (deriv g 1 / g 1) + k * (1 - s)) / (s * (s - 1)) := by
    intro s hs
    rw [dslope_of_ne _ hs, slope_def_field, hN1, hNs, ← hc]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv]
    ring
  have hPan : ∀ ρ, ρ ≠ 0 → g ρ ≠ 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ (fun s => -(dslope N 1 s) / s) ρ := by
    intro ρ hρ hgρ
    exact (hDd.analyticAt (hUo.mem_nhds hgρ)).neg.div analyticAt_id hρ
  refine ⟨fun s => -(dslope N 1 s) / s, hPhi, hPan, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ρ hρ
    by_cases hgρ : g ρ = 0
    · have hρ1 : ρ ≠ 1 := fun h => h1 (h ▸ hgρ)
      obtain ⟨m, hm0, -, h0, hh0, hev⟩ := logDeriv_local (hA ρ) (hnz ρ)
      have hr : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun s : ℂ => 1 / (s * (s - 1))) ρ :=
        analyticAt_const.div (analyticAt_id.mul (analyticAt_id.sub analyticAt_const))
          (mul_ne_zero hρ (sub_ne_zero.mpr hρ1))
      have hq := poleData_dslope hr
      refine ⟨m, hm0, fun s => -((m : ℂ) * dslope (fun s : ℂ => 1 / (s * (s - 1))) ρ s)
          - (h0 s - s * c + k * (1 - s)) * (1 / (s * (s - 1))), ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact ((analyticAt_const.mul hq).neg).sub
          (((hh0.sub (analyticAt_id.mul analyticAt_const)).add
            (analyticAt_const.mul (analyticAt_const.sub analyticAt_id))).mul hr)
      · have hne0 : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[≠] ρ, s ≠ 0 :=
          nhdsWithin_le_nhds (isOpen_ne.mem_nhds hρ)
        have hne1 : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[≠] ρ, s ≠ 1 :=
          nhdsWithin_le_nhds (isOpen_ne.mem_nhds hρ1)
        have hneρ : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[≠] ρ, s ≠ ρ := self_mem_nhdsWithin
        filter_upwards [hev, hne0, hne1, hneρ] with s hs hs0 hs1 hsρ
        rw [hPhi s hs1, hs, dslope_of_ne _ hsρ, slope_def_field, ← hc]
        simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv]
        ring
    · refine ⟨0, by simp [hgρ], fun s => -(dslope N 1 s) / s, hPan ρ hρ hgρ, ?_⟩
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s => by simp)
  · intro z
    rcases (hA z).eventually_eq_zero_or_eventually_ne_zero with h | h
    · exact absurd h (hnz z)
    · exact h

theorem poleData_integrable {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (s : ℂ) (hs : 2 < s.re) :
    IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => Gchi χ (Real.exp u) * cexp (-s * u)) (Ioi 0) := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := Gchi_growth χ
  have hb : 0 < s.re - 2 := by linarith
  refine Integrable.mono' ((exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 hb).const_mul (max C 0)) ?_ ?_
  · exact (((measurable_Gchi χ).comp Real.measurable_exp).mul
      (by fun_prop : Measurable fun u : ℝ => cexp (-s * u))).aestronglyMeasurable
  · refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).mpr (Eventually.of_forall fun u hu => ?_)
    have hu0 : (0:ℝ) < u := hu
    have he : ‖cexp (-s * u)‖ = Real.exp (-s.re * u) := by
      rw [Complex.norm_exp]
      simp
    rw [norm_mul, he]
    have hg := hC (Real.exp u) (Real.one_le_exp hu0.le)
    calc ‖Gchi χ (Real.exp u)‖ * Real.exp (-s.re * u)
        ≤ (max C 0 * Real.exp u ^ 2) * Real.exp (-s.re * u) := by
          gcongr
          exact hg.trans (by gcongr; exact le_max_left _ _)
      _ = max C 0 * Real.exp (-(s.re - 2) * u) := by
          rw [mul_assoc, sq, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
          congr 2
          ring

    (fun u _ => (Real.hasDerivAt_exp u).hasDerivWithinAt) Real.exp_injective.injOn]
  refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun u _ => ?_)
  rw [abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos u), Complex.real_smul,
    Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast (Real.exp_pos u).ne'),
    ← Complex.ofReal_log (Real.exp_pos u).le, Real.log_exp, Complex.ofReal_exp,
    mul_left_comm, ← Complex.exp_add]

  ring

theorem poleData_char {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (adm : N = 1 ∨ χ ≠ 1) :
    ∃ Φ : ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ s : ℂ, 2 < s.re → Φ s = ∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), Gchi χ (Real.exp u) * cexp (-s * u)) ∧
      (∀ ρ, ρ ≠ 0 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ ρ ≠ 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ Φ ρ) ∧
      (∀ ρ, ρ ≠ 0 → ∃ m : ℕ, (m = 0 ↔ DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ ρ ≠ 0) ∧
        ∃ h : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ h ρ ∧
        ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[≠] ρ, Φ s = (m : ℂ) * (-1 / (ρ * (ρ - 1))) / (s - ρ) + h s) ∧
      (∀ z, ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝[≠] z, DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ w ≠ 0) := by
  by_cases hχ : χ = 1
  · have hN : N = 1 := adm.resolve_right (fun h => h hχ)
    subst hN
    simp only [DirichletCharacter.LFunction_modOne_eq]
    set g : ℂ → ℂ := Function.update (fun s => (s - 1) * riemannZeta s) 1 1 with hg_def
    have hg_ne : ∀ w : ℂ, w ≠ 1 → g w = (w - 1) * riemannZeta w := by
      intro w hw
      simp [g, Function.update_apply, hw]
    have hg1 : g 1 = 1 := by simp [g]
    have hg : Differentiable ℂ g := by
      rw [← differentiableOn_univ,
        ← differentiableOn_compl_singleton_and_continuousAt_iff (c := 1) Filter.univ_mem]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro z hz
        have hz1 : z ≠ 1 := by simpa using hz
        apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
        have hev : g =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun s => (s - 1) * riemannZeta s := by
          filter_upwards [isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds hz1] with w hw

        rw [← hρx]

theorem landau_window_ineq_int (k : ℕ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 2 < σ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => u ^ k * Real.exp ((2 - σ) * u) / (k.factorial : ℝ)) (Ioi 0) := by
  have ha : 0 < (σ - 2) / 2 := by linarith
  have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => (1 / ((σ - 2) / 2) ^ k) * Real.exp (-((σ - 2) / 2) * u)) (Ioi 0) :=
    (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 ha).const_mul _
  refine Integrable.mono' h1 (by fun_prop) ?_
  refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2 (Eventually.of_forall fun u hu => ?_)
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := le_of_lt hu
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  have h2 := landau_kernel_max k ha hu0
  have h3 : u ^ k * Real.exp ((2 - σ) * u) / (k.factorial : ℝ)
      = (u ^ k * Real.exp (-((σ - 2) / 2) * u) / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-((σ - 2) / 2) * u) := by
    have : (2 - σ) * u = -((σ - 2) / 2) * u + -((σ - 2) / 2) * u := by ring
    rw [this, Real.exp_add]; ring
  rw [h3]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (Real.exp_pos _).le

theorem landau_window_ineq {g R : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : Measurable g) {C₀ : ℝ}
    (hC : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u → |g u| ≤ C₀ * Real.exp (2 * u)) {σ θ U V : ℝ} (hσ : 2 < σ) (hθ : θ < σ) (hU : 0 < U)
    (hR : IntegrableOn (fun u => R u * Real.exp (-θ * u)) (Icc U V))
    (hR' : ∀ u ∈ Icc U V, 0 ≤ R u ∧ g u ≤ R u) (k : ℕ) (γ : ℝ) :
    ‖∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (g u : ℂ) * (u : ℂ) ^ k * cexp (-((σ : ℂ) + γ * I) * u) / (k.factorial : ℂ)‖ ≤
      2 * (1 / (σ - θ) ^ k) * (∫ u in Icc U V, R u * Real.exp (-θ * u)) -
        (∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (g u : ℂ) * (u : ℂ) ^ k * cexp (-(σ : ℂ) * u) / (k.factorial : ℂ)).re +
        2 * C₀ * ∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ) \ Icc U V, u ^ k * Real.exp ((2 - σ) * u) / (k.factorial : ℝ) := by
  set w : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => u ^ k * Real.exp (-σ * u) / (k.factorial : ℝ) with hw
  set h : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => u ^ k * Real.exp ((2 - σ) * u) / (k.factorial : ℝ) with hh
  have hhi : IntegrableOn h (Ioi 0) := landau_window_ineq_int k hσ
  have hw0 : ∀ u, 0 ≤ u → 0 ≤ w u := fun u hu => by simp only [hw]; positivity
  have hwm : Measurable w := by simp only [hw]; fun_prop
  have hb : ∀ u, 0 ≤ u → |g u| * w u ≤ C₀ * h u := fun u hu => by
    have : C₀ * h u = C₀ * Real.exp (2 * u) * w u := by
      simp only [hw, hh]
      have : (2 - σ) * u = 2 * u + -σ * u := by ring
      rw [this, Real.exp_add]; ring
    rw [this]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hC u hu) (hw0 u hu)
  have hI1 : IntegrableOn (fun u => |g u| * w u) (Ioi 0) := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (hhi.const_mul C₀) (hg.abs.mul hwm).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2 (Eventually.of_forall fun u hu => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (hw0 u (le_of_lt hu)))]
    exact hb u (le_of_lt hu)
  have hI2 : IntegrableOn (fun u => g u * w u) (Ioi 0) := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (hhi.const_mul C₀) (hg.mul hwm).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2 (Eventually.of_forall fun u hu => ?_)
    rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (hw0 u (le_of_lt hu)), Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hb u (le_of_lt hu)
  have hL : ‖∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (g u : ℂ) * (u : ℂ) ^ k * cexp (-((σ : ℂ) + γ * I) * u) / (k.factorial : ℂ)‖
      ≤ ∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), |g u| * w u := by
    refine (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun u hu => ?_
    have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := le_of_lt hu
    have hre : (-((σ : ℂ) + γ * I) * u).re = -σ * u := by simp
    simp only [hw, norm_div, norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_exp, hre,
      Complex.norm_natCast, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hu0]
    ring
  have hM : (∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (g u : ℂ) * (u : ℂ) ^ k * cexp (-(σ : ℂ) * u) / (k.factorial : ℂ)).re
      = ∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), g u * w u := by
    have : (fun u : ℝ => (g u : ℂ) * (u : ℂ) ^ k * cexp (-(σ : ℂ) * u) / (k.factorial : ℂ))
        = fun u : ℝ => ((g u * w u : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      funext u
      simp only [hw]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [this, integral_complex_ofReal, Complex.ofReal_re]
  have hI3 : IntegrableOn (fun u => |g u| * w u + g u * w u) (Ioi 0) := hI1.add hI2
  have hsub : Icc U V ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ) := fun u hu => lt_of_lt_of_le hU hu.1
  have hsplit := integral_inter_add_diff (μ := volume) (s := Ioi (0 : ℝ)) (t := Icc U V)
    measurableSet_Icc hI3
  rw [inter_eq_right.2 hsub, integral_add hI1 hI2] at hsplit
  have hA : ∫ u in Icc U V, (|g u| * w u + g u * w u)
      ≤ 2 * (1 / (σ - θ) ^ k) * (∫ u in Icc U V, R u * Real.exp (-θ * u)) := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    refine setIntegral_mono_on (hI3.mono_set hsub) (hR.const_mul _) measurableSet_Icc fun u hu => ?_
    have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := le_of_lt (hsub hu)
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hR' u hu
    have h3 : |g u| + g u ≤ 2 * R u := by
      rcases abs_cases (g u) with h | h <;> linarith [h.1]
    have h4 : w u ≤ 1 / (σ - θ) ^ k * Real.exp (-θ * u) := by
      have h5 := landau_kernel_max k (sub_pos.2 hθ) hu0
      have h6 : w u = (u ^ k * Real.exp (-(σ - θ) * u) / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-θ * u) := by
        simp only [hw]
        have : -σ * u = -(σ - θ) * u + -θ * u := by ring
        rw [this, Real.exp_add]; ring
      rw [h6]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h5 (Real.exp_pos _).le
    calc |g u| * w u + g u * w u = (|g u| + g u) * w u := by ring
      _ ≤ (2 * R u) * w u := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h3 (hw0 u hu0)
      _ ≤ (2 * R u) * (1 / (σ - θ) ^ k * Real.exp (-θ * u)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 (by linarith)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hB : ∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ) \ Icc U V, (|g u| * w u + g u * w u)
      ≤ 2 * C₀ * ∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ) \ Icc U V, h u := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    refine setIntegral_mono_on (hI3.mono_set diff_subset) ((hhi.mono_set diff_subset).const_mul _)
      (measurableSet_Ioi.diff measurableSet_Icc) fun u hu => ?_
    have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := le_of_lt hu.1
    have h1 := hb u hu0
    have h2 : g u * w u ≤ |g u| * w u := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (hw0 u hu0)
    linarith
  rw [hM]
  linarith

end Deduction

  have h1 := kernel_integral k a ha
  rw [integral_undef h] at h1
  have : 0 < (a ^ (k + 1))⁻¹ := by positivity
  linarith

lemma landau_tails_chernoff (k : ℕ) {s l U V : ℝ} (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hs : l < s) :
    ∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ) \ Icc U V, u ^ k * Real.exp (-s * u) / (k.factorial : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp (-(l * V)) * ((s - l) ^ (k + 1))⁻¹ + Real.exp (l * U) * ((s + l) ^ (k + 1))⁻¹ := by
  have ha : 0 < s - l := by linarith
  have hb : 0 < s + l := by linarith
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith
  have i1 := (landau_tails_integrable k ha).const_mul (Real.exp (-(l * V)))
  have i2 := (landau_tails_integrable k hb).const_mul (Real.exp (l * U))
  have i0 := landau_tails_integrable k hs0
  have i3 := i1.add i2
  rw [← kernel_integral k _ ha, ← kernel_integral k _ hb, ← integral_const_mul, ← integral_const_mul,
    ← integral_add i1 i2]
  have hm : MeasurableSet (Ioi (0 : ℝ) \ Icc U V) := measurableSet_Ioi.diff measurableSet_Icc
  refine le_trans (setIntegral_mono_on (IntegrableOn.mono_set i0 sdiff_subset)
    (IntegrableOn.mono_set i3 sdiff_subset) hm ?_) (setIntegral_mono_set i3 ?_ sdiff_subset.eventuallyLE)
  · intro u hu
    have hu0 : 0 < u := hu.1
    have hf : 0 < (k.factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hp : 0 ≤ u ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
    have e1 : Real.exp (-(l * V)) * Real.exp (-(s - l) * u) = Real.exp (-s * u + l * (u - V)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    have e2 : Real.exp (l * U) * Real.exp (-(s + l) * u) = Real.exp (-s * u + l * (U - u)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    have key : Real.exp (-s * u) ≤ Real.exp (-s * u + l * (u - V)) + Real.exp (-s * u + l * (U - u)) := by
      have hn := hu.2
      rw [mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at hn
      rcases hn with h | h
      · have : Real.exp (-s * u) ≤ Real.exp (-s * u + l * (U - u)) :=
          Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hl (sub_nonneg.2 h.le)])
        linarith [Real.exp_pos (-s * u + l * (u - V))]
      · have : Real.exp (-s * u) ≤ Real.exp (-s * u + l * (u - V)) :=
          Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hl (sub_nonneg.2 h.le)])
        linarith [Real.exp_pos (-s * u + l * (U - u))]
    rw [← e1, ← e2] at key
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left key hp
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    calc _ = u ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (-s * u) := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := this
      _ = _ := by ring
  · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with u hu
    have hu0 : 0 < u := hu
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
    positivity

lemma landau_tails_pow (k : ℕ) {σ a x c : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (h : x + k * ((σ - a) / a) ≤ c) :
    Real.exp x * (a ^ (k + 1))⁻¹ ≤ Real.exp c / a / σ ^ k := by
  have h1 : σ / a ≤ Real.exp ((σ - a) / a) := by
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp ((σ - a) / a)
    have e : (σ - a) / a + 1 = σ / a := by field_simp; ring
    linarith
  have h2 : (σ / a) ^ k ≤ Real.exp (k * ((σ - a) / a)) := by
    rw [Real.exp_nat_mul]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h1 k
  have h3 : Real.exp x * (σ / a) ^ k ≤ Real.exp c := by
    calc _ ≤ Real.exp x * Real.exp (k * ((σ - a) / a)) := by gcongr
      _ = Real.exp (x + k * ((σ - a) / a)) := (Real.exp_add _ _).symm
      _ ≤ _ := Real.exp_le_exp.2 h
  calc _ = Real.exp x * (σ / a) ^ k / a / σ ^ k := by
        rw [div_pow, pow_succ]; field_simp
    _ ≤ _ := by gcongr

theorem landau_tails {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ σ : ℝ, 2 < σ ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ U : ℝ, 1 ≤ U → ∃ k : ℕ, U ≤ k ∧
      ∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ) \ Icc U ((1 + δ) * U), u ^ k * Real.exp ((2 - σ) * u) / (k.factorial : ℝ) ≤ C / σ ^ k := by
  obtain ⟨l, hl2, hl⟩ : ∃ l : ℝ, 2 < l ∧ l * δ = 6 + 2 * δ := by
    refine ⟨2 + 6 / δ, by have : 0 < 6 / δ := by positivity
                          linarith, by field_simp; ring⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = l * (1 + δ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hMl : l < M := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ σ : ℝ, σ = M * (2 + l) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hσ1 : l * (2 + l) < σ := by rw [hσ]; gcongr
  have hs : l < σ - 2 := by nlinarith
  have ha : 0 < σ - 2 - l := by linarith
  have hb : 0 < σ - 2 + l := by linarith
  have hσ0 : 0 < σ := by linarith
  refine ⟨σ, by linarith, Real.exp 1 / (σ - 2 - l) + Real.exp 0 / (σ - 2 + l), fun U hU => ?_⟩
  have hx : 0 ≤ (1 + δ / 2) * σ * U := by positivity
  have hk1 := Nat.le_ceil ((1 + δ / 2) * σ * U)
  have hk2 := (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one hx).le
  set k := ⌈(1 + δ / 2) * σ * U⌉₊
  have hσU : 0 ≤ σ * U := by positivity
  refine ⟨k, ?_, ?_⟩
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hδ.le hσU]
  · have e : (2 - σ) = -(σ - 2) := by ring
    rw [e, add_div]
    refine (landau_tails_chernoff k (by linarith : 0 ≤ l) hs).trans (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
    · apply landau_tails_pow k hσ0 ha
      have e1 : (σ - (σ - 2 - l)) / (σ - 2 - l) = 1 / (M - 1) := by
        have : 0 < M - 1 := by linarith
        rw [div_eq_div_iff ha.ne' this.ne', hσ]; ring
      have e2 : (1 + δ / 2) * σ = M * (M - 1) := by
        have : (1 + δ / 2) * (2 + l) = M - 1 := by rw [hM]; nlinarith
        rw [hσ, ← this]; ring
      have hM1 : 1 ≤ M - 1 := by linarith
      have e3 : (k : ℝ) * (1 / (M - 1)) ≤ M * U + 1 := by
        rw [mul_one_div, div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
        rw [e2] at hk2
        nlinarith
      have e4 : l * ((1 + δ) * U) = M * U := by rw [hM]; ring
      rw [e1, e4]; linarith
    · apply landau_tails_pow k hσ0 hb
      have e1 : (k : ℝ) * ((σ - (σ - 2 + l)) / (σ - 2 + l)) = -((k : ℝ) * (l - 2) / (σ - 2 + l)) := by
        ring
      have e2 : (1 + δ / 2) * (l - 2) = l + 1 := by nlinarith
      have e3 : l * U ≤ (k : ℝ) * (l - 2) / (σ - 2 + l) := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hb]
        have h1 : (1 + δ / 2) * σ * U * (l - 2) ≤ k * (l - 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk1 (by linarith)
        have h2 : (1 + δ / 2) * σ * U * (l - 2) = (l + 1) * σ * U := by rw [← e2]; ring
        have h3 : l * (σ - 2 + l) ≤ (l + 1) * σ := by nlinarith
        have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h3 (by linarith : 0 ≤ U)
        nlinarith
      rw [e1]; linarith

end Deduction

theorem landau_pole_asym_deriv (c ρ z : ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (fun s : ℂ => c * (s - ρ)⁻¹) z
      = c * ((-1) ^ k * (k.factorial : ℂ) * ((z - ρ) ^ (k + 1))⁻¹) := by

  have e := congrFun (iteratedDeriv_comp_sub_const k (fun t : ℂ => t⁻¹) ρ) z
  rw [e, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate, show (fun t : ℂ => t⁻¹) = Inv.inv from rfl, iter_deriv_inv,
    show (-1 - k : ℤ) = -((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]

theorem landau_pole_asym {Φ : ℂ → ℂ} {z ρ c : ℂ} {r r' : ℝ} (hρ : ρ ∈ Metric.ball z r) (hne : ρ ≠ z)
    (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (Metric.ball z r \ {ρ}))
    (hp : ∃ h : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ h ρ ∧ ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[≠] ρ, Φ s = c / (s - ρ) + h s)
    (h0 : 0 < r') (h1 : r' < r) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ,
      ‖(-1) ^ k * iteratedDeriv k Φ z / (k.factorial : ℂ) - c / (z - ρ) ^ (k + 1)‖ ≤ M / r' ^ k := by
  obtain ⟨hfun, han, hev⟩ := hp
  have hopen : IsOpen (Metric.ball z r \ {ρ}) := Metric.isOpen_ball.sdiff isClosed_singleton
  set G : ℂ → ℂ := fun s => if s = ρ then hfun ρ else Φ s - c / (s - ρ) with hG
  have hGeq : G =ᶠ[𝓝 ρ] hfun := by
    rw [eventually_nhdsWithin_iff] at hev
    filter_upwards [hev] with s hs
    by_cases hsρ : s = ρ
    · rw [hsρ]
      simp [G]
    · simp only [G, if_neg hsρ]
      rw [hs (Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mpr hsρ)]
      ring
  have hGd : DifferentiableOn ℂ G (Metric.ball z r) := by
    intro s hs
    by_cases hsρ : s = ρ
    · rw [hsρ]
      exact ((hGeq.differentiableAt_iff).mpr han.differentiableAt).differentiableWithinAt
    · have hmem : s ∈ Metric.ball z r \ {ρ} := ⟨hs, hsρ⟩
      have hΦ : DifferentiableAt ℂ Φ s := (hd s hmem).differentiableAt (hopen.mem_nhds hmem)
      have hloc : G =ᶠ[𝓝 s] fun t => Φ t - c / (t - ρ) := by
        filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds hmem] with t ht
        have htρ : t ≠ ρ := ht.2
        simp only [G, if_neg htρ]
      have hd' : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun t => Φ t - c / (t - ρ)) s :=
        hΦ.sub ((differentiableAt_const c).div
          (differentiableAt_id.sub (differentiableAt_const ρ)) (sub_ne_zero.mpr hsρ))
      exact ((hloc.differentiableAt_iff).mpr hd').differentiableWithinAt
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := landau_cauchy hGd h0 h1
  refine ⟨M, fun k => ?_⟩
  have hzρ : z ≠ ρ := Ne.symm hne
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_trans h0 h1
  have hmemz : z ∈ Metric.ball z r \ {ρ} := ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hr, hzρ⟩
  have hloc : Φ =ᶠ[𝓝 z] G + fun s => c * (s - ρ)⁻¹ := by
    filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds hmemz] with t ht
    have htρ : t ≠ ρ := ht.2
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, G, if_neg htρ, div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  have hGc : ContDiffAt ℂ k G z :=
    (hGd.contDiffOn Metric.isOpen_ball).contDiffAt
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr))
  have hPc : ContDiffAt ℂ k (fun s => c * (s - ρ)⁻¹) z := by
    have hs : ContDiffAt ℂ k (fun s : ℂ => s - ρ) z := contDiffAt_id.sub contDiffAt_const
    exact contDiffAt_const.mul (hs.inv (sub_ne_zero.mpr hzρ))
  rw [hloc.iteratedDeriv_eq, iteratedDeriv_add hGc hPc, landau_pole_asym_deriv]
  have hfac : (k.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast k.factorial_ne_zero
  have hpow : ((-1 : ℂ)) ^ k * (-1) ^ k = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
  set iG := iteratedDeriv k G z
  set X := (z - ρ) ^ (k + 1)
  have e : (-1) ^ k * (iG + c * ((-1) ^ k * (k.factorial : ℂ) * X⁻¹)) / (k.factorial : ℂ) - c / X
      = (-1) ^ k * (iG / k.factorial) := by
    calc _ = (-1) ^ k * (iG / k.factorial) + ((-1) ^ k * (-1) ^ k) * c *
          ((k.factorial : ℂ) / k.factorial) * X⁻¹ - c / X := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hpow, div_self hfac, div_eq_mul_inv c]; ring
  rw [e, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, one_mul]
  exact hM k

end Deduction

theorem landau_window_contra {c d e E M C : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d) (hde : d < e) (heE : e ≤ E)
    (H : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ U₀ : ℝ, ∃ U : ℝ, U₀ ≤ U ∧ ∃ k : ℕ, U ≤ k ∧
      c / d ^ k ≤ M / e ^ k + C * Real.exp (η * U) / E ^ k) : False := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, U₀, hU₀⟩ := landau_growth_contra (C := |M| + |C|) hc hd hde
  obtain ⟨U, hU, k, hk, hle⟩ := H η hη (max U₀ 0)
  have h1 := hU₀ U ((le_max_left _ _).trans hU) k hk
  have hU0 : 0 ≤ U := (le_max_right _ _).trans hU
  have he : 0 < e := hd.trans hde
  have hek : 0 < e ^ k := pow_pos he k
  have hexp : 1 ≤ Real.exp (η * U) := Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)
  have h2 : M / e ^ k ≤ |M| * Real.exp (η * U) / e ^ k := by
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hek.le
    exact (le_abs_self M).trans (le_mul_of_one_le_right (abs_nonneg M) hexp)
  have h3 : C * Real.exp (η * U) / E ^ k ≤ |C| * Real.exp (η * U) / e ^ k := by
    apply div_le_div₀ (by positivity) _ hek (pow_le_pow_left₀ he.le heE k)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have h4 : (|M| + |C|) * Real.exp (η * U) / e ^ k
      = |M| * Real.exp (η * U) / e ^ k + |C| * Real.exp (η * U) / e ^ k := by ring
  linarith

theorem landau_window_key {g : ℝ → ℝ} {Φ : ℂ → ℂ} {Z : Set ℂ} (hP : PoleData g Φ Z) {θ δ : ℝ}
    (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hW : WindowHypU g θ δ) :
    ∃ σ : ℝ, 2 < σ ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ U₀ : ℝ, ∃ U : ℝ, U₀ ≤ U ∧ ∃ k : ℕ, U ≤ k ∧ ∀ γ : ℝ,
      ‖(-1) ^ k * iteratedDeriv k Φ ((σ : ℂ) + γ * I) / (k.factorial : ℂ)‖ +
        ((-1) ^ k * iteratedDeriv k Φ (σ : ℂ) / (k.factorial : ℂ)).re ≤
        C * Real.exp (η * U) / (σ - θ) ^ k := by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ, C, hC⟩ := landau_tails hδ
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hP.growth
  have hC₀0 : 0 ≤ C₀ := by

  obtain ⟨U, hU, R, hR1, hR2, hR3⟩ := hW η hη (max U₀ 1)

  obtain ⟨k, hk, hk'⟩ := hC U hU1
  refine ⟨U, (le_max_left _ _).trans hU, k, hk, fun γ => ?_⟩
  have h := landau_window_ineq hP.meas hC₀ hσ (by linarith : θ < σ) (by linarith : 0 < U) hR1 hR2 k γ
  rw [landau_coeff hP k (s := (σ : ℂ) + γ * I) (by simpa using hσ),
    landau_coeff hP k (s := (σ : ℂ)) (by simpa using hσ)]
  have hst : 0 < σ - θ := by linarith
  have hstk : 0 < (σ - θ) ^ k := pow_pos hst k
  have hexp : 1 ≤ Real.exp (η * U) := Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)
  have h1 : 2 * (1 / (σ - θ) ^ k) * (∫ u in Icc U ((1 + δ) * U), R u * Real.exp (-θ * u))
      ≤ 2 * (1 / (σ - θ) ^ k) * Real.exp (η * U) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hR3 (by positivity)
  have h2 : C / σ ^ k ≤ |C| * Real.exp (η * U) / (σ - θ) ^ k := by
    apply div_le_div₀ (by positivity) _ hstk (pow_le_pow_left₀ hst.le (by linarith) k)
    exact (le_abs_self C).trans (le_mul_of_one_le_right (abs_nonneg C) hexp)
  have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hk'.trans h2) (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * C₀)
  have h4 : (2 + 2 * C₀ * |C|) * Real.exp (η * U) / (σ - θ) ^ k
      = 2 * (1 / (σ - θ) ^ k) * Real.exp (η * U)
        + 2 * C₀ * (|C| * Real.exp (η * U) / (σ - θ) ^ k) := by ring

theorem landau_window {g : ℝ → ℝ} {Φ : ℂ → ℂ} {Z : Set ℂ} (hP : PoleData g Φ Z) {θ δ : ℝ}
    (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hW : WindowHypU g θ δ) : ∀ ρ ∈ Z, ρ.re ≤ θ := by
  intro ρ₀ h₀
  by_contra hρ₀
  rw [not_le] at hρ₀
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ, C, hkey⟩ := landau_window_key hP hθ hθ1 hδ hW
  have hle : ∀ ρ ∈ Z, ρ.re < σ := fun ρ hρ => (landau_pole_re_le hP ρ hρ).trans_lt hσ
  rcases landau_dichotomy hP.iso hle hθ (by linarith) h₀ hρ₀ with
    ⟨D, hD, hfree, ρ₁, h₁, hρ₁⟩ | ⟨β, hβZ, hβ, r, hr1, hr2, huniq⟩
  · obtain ⟨γ, ρ, hρ, r, hr1, hr2, huniq⟩ := landau_nearest hP.iso hle (by linarith : D < σ) h₁ hρ₁
    obtain ⟨c, hc, -, hp⟩ := hP.pole ρ hρ
    set z : ℂ := (σ : ℂ) + γ * I with hz
    have hzre : z.re = σ := by simp [hz]
    have hne : ρ ≠ z := by
      intro h
      have := hle ρ hρ
      rw [h, hzre] at this
      exact lt_irrefl _ this
    have hd : 0 < ‖z - ρ‖ := norm_pos_iff.2 (sub_ne_zero.2 hne.symm)

theorem windowHyp_of_rpow_eventually (K η : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ Y₁ : ℝ, ∀ Y : ℝ, Y₁ ≤ Y → 1 ≤ Y ∧ K * Real.log Y ≤ Y ^ η := by
  have h2 : 0 < η / 2 := by positivity
  have h1 := (tendsto_rpow_atTop h2).eventually_ge_atTop (K / (η / 2))
  obtain ⟨Y₁, hY₁⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 (h1.and (eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)))
  refine ⟨Y₁, fun Y hY => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := hY₁ Y hY
  refine ⟨hb, ?_⟩
  have hY0 : 0 < Y := by linarith
  have hl := Real.log_le_rpow_div hY0.le h2
  have hp : 0 ≤ Y ^ (η / 2) := by positivity
  have he : Y ^ η = Y ^ (η / 2) * Y ^ (η / 2) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hY0]; congr 1; ring
  calc K * Real.log Y ≤ K * (Y ^ (η / 2) / (η / 2)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl hK
    _ = K / (η / 2) * Y ^ (η / 2) := by ring
    _ ≤ Y ^ (η / 2) * Y ^ (η / 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha hp
    _ = Y ^ η := he.symm

theorem windowHyp_of_rpow (F : CharFamily) {θ δ C : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (h : ∀ Y₀ : ℝ, ∃ Y : ℝ, Y₀ ≤ Y ∧ ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc Y (Y ^ (1 + δ)), Gm F y ≤ C * y ^ θ) :
    WindowHyp F θ δ := by
  intro η hη Y₀
  obtain ⟨Y₁, hY₁⟩ := windowHyp_of_rpow_eventually (|C| * δ) η (by positivity) hη
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, hb⟩ := h (max Y₀ Y₁)
  obtain ⟨h1, hK⟩ := hY₁ Y (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hY)
  have hY0 : 0 < Y := by linarith
  have hle : Y ≤ Y ^ (1 + δ) := by
    calc Y = Y ^ (1 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_one Y).symm
      _ ≤ Y ^ (1 + δ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h1 (by linarith)
  have heq : Set.EqOn (fun y : ℝ => |C| * y ^ θ * y ^ (-θ - 1)) (fun y : ℝ => |C| * y⁻¹)
      (Set.Icc Y (Y ^ (1 + δ))) := by
    intro y hy
    have hy0 : 0 < y := lt_of_lt_of_le hY0 hy.1
    simp only
    rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hy0, show θ + (-θ - 1) = -1 by ring, Real.rpow_neg_one]
  refine ⟨Y, le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hY, fun y => |C| * y ^ θ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine (integrableOn_congr_fun heq measurableSet_Icc).2 ?_
    refine ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc ?_
    exact continuousOn_const.mul (continuousOn_id.inv₀ fun y hy => (lt_of_lt_of_le hY0 hy.1).ne')
  · intro y hy
    have hy0 : 0 < y := lt_of_lt_of_le hY0 hy.1
    have hp : 0 ≤ y ^ θ := by positivity
    exact ⟨by positivity, (hb y hy).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) hp)⟩
  · rw [setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc heq, integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hle, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      integral_inv_of_pos hY0 (lt_of_lt_of_le hY0 hle),
      Real.log_div (lt_of_lt_of_le hY0 hle).ne' hY0.ne', Real.log_rpow hY0]
    calc |C| * ((1 + δ) * Real.log Y - Real.log Y) = |C| * δ * Real.log Y := by ring
      _ ≤ Y ^ η := hK

theorem UpperTheory.zeta_ne_zero_of_everyCharacter (h : UpperTheory.EveryCharacter) : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 / 2 < s.re → s ≠ 1 → riemannZeta s ≠ 0 := fun s hs h1 => by
  have := h 1 1 s hs (Or.inr h1)
  rwa [DirichletCharacter.LFunction_modOne_eq] at this

theorem UpperTheory.riemannHypothesis_of_everyCharacter (h : UpperTheory.EveryCharacter) : RiemannHypothesis := by
  intro s hs hn h1
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
  · have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; rw [riemannZeta_zero] at hs; norm_num at hs
    have h1s : (1 - s) ≠ 1 := fun e => hs0 (by simpa using e)
    have hz : riemannZeta (1 - s) ≠ 0 := UpperTheory.zeta_ne_zero_of_everyCharacter h (1 - s) (by simp; linarith) h1s
    have hc : completedRiemannZeta s = completedRiemannZeta (1 - s) := (completedRiemannZeta_one_sub s).symm
    have h1s0 : (1 - s) ≠ 0 := fun e => h1 (by linear_combination -e)
    rw [riemannZeta_def_of_ne_zero hs0, div_eq_zero_iff] at hs
    rcases hs with hs | hs
    · exact hz (by rw [riemannZeta_def_of_ne_zero h1s0, ← hc, hs, zero_div])
    · obtain ⟨n, hn'⟩ := Complex.Gammaℝ_eq_zero_iff.1 hs
      rcases n with _ | n
      · exact hs0 (by simpa using hn')
      · exact hn ⟨n, by rw [hn']; push_cast; ring⟩
  · exact UpperTheory.zeta_ne_zero_of_everyCharacter h s hgt h1 hs
